title: Deluxe Ocean View Room
imageAlt: Deluxe ocean view bedroom with king bed and warm wooden paneling
description: A serene retreat framed by warm timber, tactile linens and uninterrupted water views.
overview: Designed with quiet sophistication, the Deluxe Ocean View Room layers natural oak, hand-finished brass and soft ambient lighting around a cloud-like king bed. Floor-to-ceiling windows open to a private outlook across the sea.

A dedicated writing desk, high-speed Wi-Fi and a 55-inch Smart TV balance effortless work with unhurried downtime. The in-room coffee bar is prepared with a curated selection of teas and locally roasted coffee.
The marble bathroom is a sanctuary of its own, complete with a rain shower, deep soaking tub and spa-grade amenities selected for restorative rituals.

Luxury marble bathroom with a freestanding bathtub

title: Executive Ocean Suite
imageAlt: Executive suite with seating lounge, balcony and ocean view
description: An expansive suite where a private lounge and balcony slow every moment down.
overview: The Executive Ocean Suite introduces a generous living lounge to the Victoria Club experience, with low-slung seating, sculptural lighting and a wraparound balcony oriented toward the horizon.
Every considered detail supports an intuitive stay: fast Wi-Fi, a large Smart TV, discreet work surface and a refreshment bar for mornings spent at your own pace.
In the ensuite marble bathroom, a deep soaking tub, rain shower and dual vanity create a graceful ritual before evening plans.

Contemporary hotel bathroom with polished stone finishes
Blue ocean beyond a private balcony
Elegant suite workspace with coffee service

title: Presidential Pool Residence
imageAlt: Ultra-luxury villa bedroom opening to a private infinity pool deck
description: A private residence with an infinity pool, marble bath and the sea on every horizon.
overview: The Presidential Pool Residence is Victoria Club Hotel at its most private: a sun-drenched residence with a personal infinity pool, abundant indoor-outdoor living and a cinematic sea outlook.
A salon-style lounge, private dining setting, attentive butler service and state-of-the-art entertainment create room for gathering, working or simply retreating from the world.
The master marble bathroom combines a sculptural soaking tub, rain shower and elevated spa amenities, while the second bedroom makes every stay comfortably generous.

title: Classic Garden Room
imageAlt: Classic garden room with queen bed and warm earthy tones
description: A warm, easy room that opens onto the quiet green of the inner garden.
overview: The Classic Garden Room pairs a plush queen bed with hand-woven textiles, warm timber floors and a window framing the hotel's inner garden. It is a room designed for slow mornings.
Thoughtful comforts include high-speed Wi-Fi, a 43-inch Smart TV, a curated tea tray and a compact writing nook lit for late reading.
The bathroom walks the same warm palette with a rain shower, brass fittings and botanical bath amenities.

title: Premier City Suite
imageAlt: Premier suite with king bed and sweeping city views
description: A bright corner suite with lounge seating and the pink city skyline at dusk.
overview: The Premier City Suite occupies a quiet corner of the hotel, with a separate lounge, floor-to-ceiling glazing and an outlook over Jaipur's terracotta rooftops toward the hills.
A curated minibar, Nespresso station, generous work desk and 55-inch Smart TV make the suite equally suited to work trips and unhurried holidays.
The ensuite bathroom pairs a deep soaking tub with a rain shower, dual vanity and premium amenities.

title: Heritage Club Room
imageAlt: Heritage room with king bed, arches and Rajasthani accents
description: Restored arches, carved wood and soft lamp light in the hotel's oldest wing.
overview: The Heritage Club Room sits in the hotel's original wing, where restored arches, carved jharokha-inspired details and hand-block-printed fabrics honour the building's Rajasthani roots.
Modern comfort is quietly present: high-speed Wi-Fi, a 50-inch Smart TV, a well-stocked tea tray and blackout drapery for deep sleep.
The bathroom combines sandstone finishes with a rain shower and botanical bath amenities.

title: Family Courtyard Suite
imageAlt: Family suite with lounge, two sleeping areas and courtyard view
description: Two bedrooms, a shared lounge and the fountain courtyard just outside.
overview: The Family Courtyard Suite spreads across two connected bedrooms and a central lounge, giving families and small groups room to gather and space to retreat.
The lounge carries a dining nook, games shelf, 65-inch Smart TV and a replenished refreshment bar, while both bedrooms have their own climate control and blackout curtains.
The family bathroom offers a bathtub for younger guests alongside a walk-in rain shower.

title: Royal Honeymoon Villa
imageAlt: Romantic villa with four-poster bed and private plunge pool
description: A private villa with four-poster bed, plunge pool and candlelit terrace dining.
overview: The Royal Honeymoon Villa is the hotel's most romantic address: a four-poster king bed dressed in Egyptian cotton, a canopied sitting area and a private plunge pool set within high courtyard walls.
Evenings can be arranged on the terrace with candlelit dining for two, while mornings arrive with a complimentary champagne breakfast and slow room service.
The marble bathroom centres on a double-ended soaking tub beside a rain shower, with bespoke amenities drawn from Rajasthani rose and sandalwood.
